d2124.Raw_Article: 2124 Ka. koraḍu, koḍḍa a kind of rainbow appearing in a straight form. Te. koraḍu a red streak in the clouds, (B.) a gleam or streak of a rainbow in the clouds; ( VPK ) koraḍu, korru rainbow. Konḍa (BB) kuṟveli id. DED(S) 1766.
